name: Japanese Temple - Structure
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: hellojaviergarcia
description: A Japanese Temple is a tranquil in plains complex in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by traditional Shinto and Buddhist architecture, featuring sweeping curved eaves, tiered pagodas and torii gates, stone lanterns, and wooden joinery.
works: A Japanese Temple is a tranquil in plains complex in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by traditional Shinto and Buddhist architecture, featuring sweeping curved eaves, tiered pagodas and torii gates, stone lanterns, and wooden joinery: its structures generate in new worlds.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged; a new world needed (structures generate with new chunks)
